name: Breeder
description: Ditto pairs with female Pokemon in the pasture to produce eggs (Cobbreeding format). Shiny Ditto doubles the offspring's shiny chance.

prof1Multiplier.label: Prof 1 ★☆☆☆☆ Cooldown
prof1Multiplier.tooltip: Multiplier on Cobbreeding's [min, max] breeding-ticks range at Proficiency 1. 1.0x = same speed as vanilla Cobbreeding native pasture breeding.

prof5Multiplier.label: Prof 5 ★★★★★ Cooldown
prof5Multiplier.tooltip: Cooldown multiplier at Proficiency 5. Default 0.5x = twice as fast as vanilla Cobbreeding.

shinyDittoBonus.label: Shiny Ditto Shiny Bonus
shinyDittoBonus.tooltip: Shiny chance multiplier applied when the breeding Ditto is shiny. 2.0x = doubled shiny odds (1/4096 instead of 1/8192).
